data.description:
FOR SPT VERSION ~4.0 ONLY

New Content:

Weapons

  • Added PMM12 and associated attachments

  • Added M78 and associated attachments

  • Added Cheytac M200 Intervention

  • Remastered Remington ACR -> Now Magpul Masada

  • Remastered HK XM8

  • Added SV98M

  • Added Henry Big Boy Steel .357 Lever Action Rifle

  • Added Pit Viper

  • Added UMP 9

  • Added Colt RO991

  • Added Ruger 57

  • Added PSA Rock 57

  • Added Marlin 1894 Dark Tracker .44 Magnum Lever Action Rifle

  • Added Barrett M107A1

  • Added Barret XM109

Achievements

  • Added custom achievements

Quests

  • New quest to unlock Barret M107A1 trader assort

Bug Fixes:

  • Remington MSR Dual-Port muzzle brake no longer accepts attachments

  • CZ Scorpion scope position corrected.

  • Fal 65 round drum locale fix - description changed to 60 rounds instead of 65

  • Quest fix - nostalgia - rep is now 0.04 instead of 0.4

To Do:

HK G3 removed for Armory 2.0. It will be remastered in the next update.

Happy Holidays from the WTT Team!

dependencies.name: WTT - CommonLib
dependencies.teaser: A modding utility library that eliminates boilerplate when adding custom items, quests, characters, and more to SPT

versions.description:
• added customisation helper methods
  • bugfixes
  • sanity checks (thanks bushtail)
  • more i’m definitely forgetting

I wonder why commonlib is updating today….

Fixed Fika loading issue with icons!

  • added new ImageManager that works similar to spt’s BundleManager, creating a cache of icons and textures if needed

• added questhelper
  • force image cache if using fika because of local headless skill issue
added helper method for dogtag quests

HOTFIX NUMBER 2 FOR THE DAY REEEEEEE

  • fixed caliberhelper from being completely broken. PLEASE DOWNLOAD THIS VERSION IF YOU UPDATED TODAY.
• fixed questhelper adding to empty weapon conditions (specifically a punisher part 4 issue)

• added weapon mod quest helper method
  • added CustomDialogueService for custom NPC Dialogues
  • changed CaliberHelper to process deferred like modslots (should allow for better compatibility for ammo)
  • fixed custom modslot images becoming blurry on low texture settings (Thanks Pein!)

• Implemented random loot container support for customitemserviceextended
  • Added save method to confighelper

Version so good it jumped a number!

  • new hideout crafting expansion by pein, now supports multi-endproducts and endproducts with nested children
  • reworked custom parent mapping into a server service + client attribute (also by pein)
  • separated logic in the slothelper methods, added a new one

• added new itemservice helper for adding items to blacklist
  • fixed nuget package forcibly including the en.json locale for the salvage zones in your project /bonk
  • fixed slothelper method and added support for creating new slot info
• fixed hideout crafts service not supporting anything but arrays /bonk

• Added new helper to slothelper to add ids by name
  • Added fix custom item sort order patch (thanks Pein! ❤️ )
  • Added new “Salvage” zones to possible quest types
  • Added locales for the salvage zone interactions
  • Fixed hideout crafts not supporting .jsonc /bonk

• FINALLY fixed salvage zones :prayge:
  • salvage zone UI update + icon!
  • add random craft result amount options
  • initialized buyrestrictioncurrent for traderhelper barters (ty for the detailed bug report!)
  • added client handling for random craft amounts
  • added better validation warnings and a config for validation logging
  • added fixplugintypesserialization patcher (thank you tarkin ❤️)
  • added new quest service for making quest items
  • removed dependency on spt customitemservice
reduced the error logging to be behind config. MODDERS THAT USE COMMONLIB - ENABLE ITEM DEBUGGING IN THE CONFIG AND FIX YOUR SHIT

fixed countercreator conditions (thanks hiddencirno!)

THIS WILL LIKELY BE THE LAST VERSION OF 4.0.x COMMONLIB

4.1.x is the future, and the future is now old man

data.description:
For SPT ~4.0 ONLY

Mostly a hotfix/ balancing pass.

Fixes

  • New weapons added to quests

  • M200 bolt cycle animation smoothing

  • Numerous locale fixes

  • Fixed missing Wages of Sin sounds

  • M249 scope bone renamed

  • Proper mastery system enabled for Marlin Dark Tracker and Ruger 57

  • Added tactical slot to Magpul Masada receiver

  • .408 cheytac rounds no longer fit in .338 weapons/magazines

Balancing

  • XM109 25x59 grenades balanced
  • Rebalancing of XM109 and M107A1

New Content

  • A545 5.45x39 Rifle added - THANKS TO ECO!

  • HK USC .45 ACP carbine added

Happy New Years!

Tron

versions.description: added helper method for dogtag quests

• added questhelper
  • force image cache if using fika because of local headless skill issue

Fixed Fika loading issue with icons!

  • added new ImageManager that works similar to spt’s BundleManager, creating a cache of icons and textures if needed

• added customisation helper methods
  • bugfixes
  • sanity checks (thanks bushtail)
  • more i’m definitely forgetting

I wonder why commonlib is updating today….

What’s Changed:

  • Fixed AddGeneratorFuel by @kittycat2002

• Changed bundle loading methods for Static Spawn Service and Audio Service to load using SPT’s BundleManager, should alleviate any fika issues. THIS WILL REQUIRE ANYONE WHO USES THESE SERVICES TO REGISTER THEIR BUNDLE IN THE BUNDLES.JSON PROPERLY, PLEASE CONSULT THE README
  • Implemented new Custom Customization Service, with support for Hideout Customizations such as floors, ceilings, walls, and shooting range marks, as well as normal customization items like dogtags and such.

• added support for nested folders for quest locales
  • added support for multiple crafts per file

Fixed more gameworld.mainplayer references for fika headless compatibility Added packet delivery system for static spawns for fika compatibility

This version works for fika and spt, it only loads the fika helper assembly if fika is present. This should hopefully fix the last issues for headless crashing on raid start, but if there are still issues let me know!
• fixes headless crash when using fika. ONLY NEEDED FOR FIKA HEADLESS USERS

• added customachievementservice & modslot helpers
  • removed debug lines causing confusion when locales/questdata weren’t present
  • fixed a major issue with customassortservice adding multiple mods assorts multiple times /bonk

• added new helper method for customitemserviceextended for secure filters
  • added missing properties to clothing configs for questrequirements and achievementrequirements (skillrequirements will have to wait until next major SPT verison)
  • fixed side locked quests not working properly /bonk
  • added buyrestrictionmax for trader barters in customitemserviceextended
  • added new customaudioservice for facecard and radio audio
  • renamed customprofileservice method from add to create for consistency

2.0.0 - Unified API Release

Major Update

  • Combined client and server CommonLib into unified framework
  • New server-side services for custom items, quests, loot, bots, and more
  • Custom item template registration with full client instantiation support
  • Updated guid: use com.wtt.commonlib dependency

Breaking Changes

  • Update BepInDependency from com.aaaWTT.ClientCommonLib to com.wtt.commonlib

See full documentation on GitHub

https://github.com/WelcomeToTarkov/WTT-CommonLib/blob/main/README.md

data.description:
Final update for SPT 4.0.13

FN Evolys Update!

This was a collaboration between the very talented individuals Choccy and HKM4 who did the heavy lifting on this project and donated it to our team for a release within WTT - Armory.

Thanks to Eukyre for touching up the textures, fixing up the sounds, and balancing the weapon. <3

Thanks to Eco for putting final touches in the Unity project itself and getting it out the door. <3

General Fixes:

Fixed AN94 hyperburst problems - Thanks Fontaine! <3

Fixed a number of existing quest issues.

More balancing among several weapon platforms.

Fixed a number of attachment filter oddities

data.description:
V 1.1.0 for SPT 3.11 ONLY

Added Content:

- Accuracy International AXMC .300 WinMag added by ProbablyEukyre

Sold at Jaeger LL3

Balancing Changes:

- M249 accuracy slightly reduced, recoil slightly increased, ergonomics slightly decreased

- XM8 barrel balancing (all barrels had the same stats originally)

- .300 Winmag cartridges slightly buffed.

Bug Fixes:

- CZ Scorpion locale fixes

- Aimpoint CS fix for frosted lens

- Handbook Parent ID fixed for HK G3SD suppressor

- Removed unused ID in IWI Carmel filters

- The new NATO stanag magazines are now correctly set to be incompatible with G36 magwell

- X-95 weapon masteries fixed

- Weapons that were missing mastery points now have point requirements

- Removed quotes around weight values in items.json

- Camo SVD Dragunov attachments are available on flea again (the main weapon itself is not since it’s a boss variant)

- Jaeger quest to handover item - fixed item turn in for CSS charging handle ( should have been obzor reflex sight)

- Fixed X95 magazine anim clipping

- Fixed IWI Carmel magazine anim clipping

- Fixed CZ Scorpion 20 round magazine animation index

- Added caliber parameter to 8mm mauser rounds

- Fixed condition error for “Weapons Trial: PMCS” quest

- Various writing issues fixed on Peacekeeper quest assorts

- Remington ACR locales overhauled

- LAR grizzly compensator handbook parent ID fixed

- 6L50 - 50 round AKM magazine now sold on flea market

- False Flag quest locales fixed and quest can now be restarted upon death

This update should fix a majority of the bugs that everyone’s outlined in the past 2 weeks. Thank you all for the reporting and the support

v 1.2.0 for SPT 3.11 ONLY

Added Content:

Added MK23 and associated attachments - available at Peacekeeper and Mechanic

Added AG-042 and AG-043 assault rifles - available at Prapor and static world spawn on Ground Zero

Added custom gas tube to the Zastava M76 - it can now use some AK handguards. - You can thank our very own QwertyAlex for this one.

Added Beretta 92FS custom compensator - Mechanic

Added HK417 handguard upgrades - You can thank Mr. Eukyre for these!

Added VSS-M “Ublyudok” integral barrel-suppressor as part of the on-going VSS-M kit that Eukyre is making.

Balancing Changes:

- 8mm Mauser has been buffed

- .300 WM has been buffed

- .338 Norma Magnum has been slightly buffed

- Hi point C9 selling price slightly reduced.

Bug Fixes

- Weapons now count towards base game quests

- Fika F8 Extract Bug fromWages of Sin audio bank error has been fixed. - TY to Kobe Thuy for helping us narrow down the error and correct it!

- AXMC .300 WM locale fixes

- CZ Scorpion bolt-release animation transition smoothed

- AEK 971 magazine check animation smoothed

- Zastava M76 now properly takes PSO scopes and other dovetail mounted optics

- Tavor X95 9mm SMG magazine check animation clipping fixed

- Added Leupold Mark IMS 35mm ring scope mount to Surgeon bolt-action rifle filters

- Added Ase Utra Borelock .338LM muzzle device to Surgeon bolt-action rifle filters

- Added CZ Scorpion 20 round transparent and 30 round polymer magazines to Skier assorts

- Patriot sounds overhauled

- PM9 no longer has incorrect foldable parameter

Thank you all for the bug reporting and the support for WTT.

Happy WTT Thursday!

- From the WTT Team

Please remove any previous installations of WTT Armory before installing this update.

Small hotfix that addresses the following bugs:

  • Arisaka json removed. It was accidentally included. The actual weapon will appear in a future update. PLEASE REMOVE ARISAKA FROM YOUR PROFILE/STASH/PMC before installing the new update.
  • MK23 rear iron sights adjusted for better camera control
  • HK HK417 muzzle brake handbook parent ID fix
  • Potential fix for AXMC 300WM bot loadout generation error
  • HK 417 handguards properly added to filters

Anti virus has been finicky and now appears to be flagging our DLL occasionally. The DLL file hasn’t changed since Armory version 1.0.

VirusTotal Link has been provided on our page.

Thank you all for the bug reporting and the support! -WTT Team
